about: The real target of each record Cloudflare proxies (scripts/dns-zone build lists them under needs_target, because the export holds Cloudflare's address, not the origin). A key is '<name> <type>' as needs_target names it; the value is either the record Route 53 gets instead, {"type": ..., "values": [...], "ttl": ...}, or {"alias_import": "<export name>"}: an alias A and AAAA to the CloudFront domain another stack exports, read with Fn::ImportValue (the exporting stack comes first in infra/aws/order.json, and keeps that export while the dns stack imports it). media is the media stack's DistributionDomain, exported as tower-media-distribution-domain (infra/aws/stacks/60-media.json, Cdn on).
